purpose: Archived user-supplied review reports and one superseded instruction. Hashes establish source/copy integrity, not correctness of claims. Archived instructions are historical evidence, not active instructions.
privacy_transformations: Replace the local workspace root with <workspace>.
Replace the personal Copilot cache/session location with <local-copilot-session-cache>.
Path-normalized text files use LF line endings and a terminal newline; logical line positions and substantive review text are preserved. Unchanged files retain original bytes.

publication_change value correction_appended_body_unchanged means a dated correction was appended after the end of the authored text, the authored body is byte-for-byte unchanged, original_sha256 hashes the authored bytes and published_sha256 hashes the whole published file.
